etym.下: 一 (yī, the baseline) with a mark hanging below it — down, under; the mirror of 上 (shàng)
etym.丢: 一 (yī, one stroke) slipping off the top of 去 (qù, go) — gone before you noticed: to lose. 丢脸 (diūliǎn)
etym.两: two things side by side under one beam — a cart's paired yoke: two of something. 两个 (liǎng ge)
etym.个: 人 (rén, a person) over one single stroke — one single thing: the all-purpose measure word
etym.中: a line straight through the middle of 口 (kǒu, a box) — dead center: middle
etym.主: a lamp with its flame on top — the dot is the flame; the one who keeps it burning: master, main. 主要 (zhǔyào)
etym.么: the little tail of 什么 (shénme) and 怎么 (zěnme) — a curl of a character, no parts worth naming
etym.习: one wing of the old 習 (xí) — a bird beating its wings, over and over: to practice. 学习 (xuéxí)
etym.买: the old 買 (mǎi) was a net over a shell 贝 (bèi) — scooping up goods: to buy
etym.云: curling vapor under the sky-lines — a cloud, the picture itself. 多云 (duōyún)
etym.互: two hooks locked into each other — each holding the other up: mutual. 互相 (hùxiāng)
etym.些: 此 (cǐ, this) + 二 (èr, two) — a couple of these: some
etym.亡: a figure slipped out of sight behind a wall — gone: to flee, to die. 死亡 (sǐwáng)
etym.京: a watchtower on a hill, cousin of 高 (gāo) — the tall buildings of the capital: 北京 (Běijīng), 南京 (Nánjīng)
etym.亮: the tall tower of 高 (gāo) set on 几 (jī, legs) — a lamp raised high: bright. 月亮 (yuèliang)
etym.亲: standing 立 (lì) by the tree 木 (mù), watching for family to come home: kin, dear. 母亲 (mǔqīn) — a picture, not the old etymology
etym.什: 亻 (person) + 十 (shí, ten) — a file of ten soldiers once; borrowed purely for its sound in 什么 (shénme)
etym.介: 人 (rén, person) between two dividing strokes — the one standing between: to introduce. 介绍 (jièshào)
etym.从: 人 (rén, person) following 人 (rén, person) — one behind the other: to follow; from
etym.他: 亻 (person) + 也 (yě) — it was the sound side long ago: he. Same build as 她 (tā)
etym.仙: 亻 (person) + 山 (shān, mountain) — the one who went up the mountain and stayed: immortal. 神仙 (shénxiān)
etym.们: 亻 (a person) tagged with 门 (mén), which gives the sound — the plural marker for people: we, they. 我们 (wǒmen)
etym.件: 亻 (person) + 牛 (niú, ox) — an ox split into pieces: an item; the measure for clothes and matters, 一件 (yí jiàn)
etym.份: 亻 (a person) + 分 (fēn, to divide) — one person's cut of the split: a share, a copy. 分 (fēn) gives the sound (fēn→fèn). 备份 (bèifèn)
etym.休: 亻 (person) + 木 (mù, tree) — a person leaning against a tree: to rest. 休息 (xiūxi)
etym.会: 人 (rén, person) + 云 (yún, cloud) — people drifting together like clouds: to meet; can
etym.伞: an umbrella drawn open — canopy, ribs and pole: umbrella
etym.但: 亻 (a person) + 旦 (dàn, sunrise), which gives the sound — borrowed long ago for 'only': but. 但是 (dànshì)
etym.位: 亻 (person) + 立 (lì, standing) — where a person stands at court: a seat, a position; the polite measure word
etym.低: 亻 (a person) stooping — 氐 (dī, a root reaching down) gives the sound and points the direction: low, to lower
etym.住: 亻 (a person) + 主 (zhǔ, the master of a house) — a person settled under the master's lamp: to live, to stay. 主 (zhǔ) gives the sound (zhǔ→zhù). 家住 (jiāzhù)
etym.体: 亻 (person) + 本 (běn, root) — a person's own root and trunk: the body
etym.作: 亻 (person) + 乍 (zhà, hints at zuò) — the maker at work: to do, to make
etym.你: 亻 (person) + 尔 (ěr), the classical you — the person being spoken to
etym.便: 亻 (person) + 更 (gēng, to change) — a person rearranging things to suit: convenient (biàn); cheap in 便宜 (piányi)
etym.信: 亻 (person) + 言 (yán, words) — a person standing by their word: to trust; a letter. 相信 (xiāngxìn)
etym.俩: 亻 (person) + 两 (liǎng, two) — two people said in one syllable: liǎ
etym.候: 亻 (person) + the sound side of 侯 (hóu) — waiting on a lord: time, to wait. 时候 (shíhou)
etym.借: 亻 (person) + 昔 (xī) — the sound side it shares with 错 (cuò) and 惜 (xī): to borrow, to lend. 借给你 (jiè gěi nǐ)
etym.假: 亻 (a person) + 叚 (jiǎ, to borrow), which gives the sound — borrowed, so not real: fake; borrowed time: a holiday. 请假 (qǐngjià)
etym.做: 亻 (person) + 故 (gù, deed) — the person behind the deed: to do
etym.停: 亻 (a traveler) + 亭 (tíng, a roadside pavilion — also the sound): pausing at the pavilion — to stop. 停止 (tíngzhǐ)
etym.健: 亻 (a person) + 建 (jiàn, to build), which gives the sound — a body built solid: strong, healthy. 健康 (jiànkāng)
etym.像: 亻 (a person) + 象 (xiàng, elephant, the thing pictured) — a person's likeness: to resemble; an image. 象 (xiàng) gives the sound
etym.元: a person with a stroke marking the head — the head first: origin; then the dollar. 元 (yuán)
etym.兔: a rabbit crouching — the dot is its bobtail: rabbit. 兔子 (tùzi)
etym.全: a lid over 王 (wáng)-shaped jade — jade without a flaw: complete. 完全 (wánquán)
etym.公: 八 (bā, to divide) + 厶 (private) — dividing what was private: public
etym.六: a little shed of a numeral — six. 六口人 (liù kǒu rén)
etym.共: two hands lifting one thing together in the old graph — shared: 一共 (yígòng), 公共 (gōnggòng)
etym.关: the bolt of the old door-graph 關 (guān), frame stripped away — to close; to concern: 没关系 (méi guānxi)
etym.兴: many hands raising a tray in the old 興 (xīng) — everyone lifting at once: to rise; spirits up, 高兴 (gāoxìng)
etym.其: a winnowing basket on a stand, borrowed for its/that — 其他 (qítā), 其实 (qíshí)
etym.再: one more 一 (yī, beam) stacked onto the frame — once more: 再见 (zàijiàn)
etym.冒: a hat (冃 mào, which also gives the sound) pulled down over the 目 (mù, eye) — charging ahead blind: to brave, to risk; what a cold does to your head. 感冒 (gǎnmào)
etym.写: 冖 (a cover) over 与 (yǔ) — settled in under the roof with pen and paper: to write. The old 寫 (xiě) was a magpie under a roof; no sound story
etym.农: the old 農 (nóng) had hands working a shell hoe; simplified past recognizing — farming. 农村人 (nóngcūn rén)
etym.冬: a rope tied off at both ends — the year knotted shut — with two ice-drops below: winter. 冬天 (dōngtiān)
etym.冰: 冫 (ice) + 水 (shuǐ, water) — water gone hard; the ice side also carries the bīng sound
etym.决: 冫 (ice) + 夬 (guài, the sound side of 快 (kuài) too) — the ice breaks, it's settled: to decide. 决定 (juédìng)
etym.冷: 冫 (ice crystals) + 令 (lìng), which hints the sound (lìng→lěng): cold. 不冷不热 (bù lěng bú rè)
etym.净: 冫 (ice) + 争 (zhēng) — the sound side it shares with 静 (jìng); clean as ice: 干净 (gānjìng)
etym.准: 冫 (ice) + 隹 (zhuī, bird) — a bird poised dead-still on ice: accurate, to allow
etym.凶: a pit with a cross scratched in it — the trap underfoot: fierce, ominous
etym.出: a foot stepping up out of a pit in the old graph — to go out. Not 山 (shān) twice, whatever it looks like
etym.分: 八 (bā, to divide) + 刀 (dāo, knife) — a knife cutting in two: fēn; a share, fèn
etym.刘: 文 (wén) + 刂 (knife) — just a surname now: 刘备 (Liú Bèi)
etym.刚: 刂 (a blade) + 冈 (gāng, a ridge), which gives the sound — hard as a tempered edge: firm; just now. 刚才 (gāngcái), 刚刚 (gānggāng)
etym.别: 另 (lìng, other) + 刂 (knife) — cut apart: to part; don't
etym.刮: 舌 (shé, tongue) + 刂 (knife) — a blade scraping like a licking tongue: to scrape; the wind scrapes too, 刮风 (guāfēng)
etym.到: 至 (zhì, an arrow struck point-down in the ground: to reach) + 刂 (dāo, the squeezed knife, giving the sound: dāo→dào): to arrive. 到了 (dàole), 得到 (dédào)
etym.刻: 刂 (knife) + 亥 (hài, the sound side of 孩 (hái) too) — notches cut into the water-clock: a quarter hour. 一刻钟 (yíkèzhōng)
etym.前: a foot riding a boat in the old graph — moving ahead without walking: front, before
etym.力: a flexed arm (or a plow being pushed) — raw strength. It IS force: 力量 (lìliàng), 努力 (nǔlì)
etym.办: 力 (lì, strength) with sweat flying off both sides — putting your back into it: to handle. 办法 (bànfǎ)
etym.加: 力 (lì, strength) + 口 (kǒu, mouth) — piling words on top: to add. 参加 (cānjiā)
etym.务: force above, 力 (lì, strength) below — work pressed onto you: duty. 服务员 (fúwùyuán)
etym.动: 云 (yún) + 力 (lì, strength) — it stands in for 重 (zhòng), the old sound side: to move. 运动 (yùndòng)
etym.助: 且 (qiě, the rough sound side) + 力 (lì, strength) — strength added on: to help. 帮助 (bāngzhù)
etym.努: 奴 (nú, a slave) over 力 (lì, muscle) — a slave's strength, all of it spent: to strive. 奴 (nú) gives the sound (nú→nǔ). 努力 (nǔlì)
etym.勿: a knife with flecks flying off it — the stern sign-post no: 请勿打扰 (qǐng wù dǎrǎo)
etym.包: 勹 (a wrap, and the bāo sound) around 巳 (sì, a curled infant) — bundled up: bag, to wrap
etym.化: 亻 (a person) upright beside the same person flipped head-over — one state turning into the other: to change. 变化 (biànhuà), 文化 (wénhuà)
etym.医: an arrow 矢 (shǐ) in the surgeon's box 匚 (fāng) — pulling arrowheads was the trade: doctor. 医院 (yīyuàn)
etym.半: an ox 牛 (niú) split down the middle by 八 (bā, divide) — half. 十点半 (shí diǎn bàn)
etym.单: a forked hunting pole in the old graph — one shaft, by itself: single. 菜单 (càidān), 简单 (jiǎndān)
etym.卖: 买 (mǎi, to buy — also gives the sound, mǎi→mài) with goods stacked on top — the other side of the counter: to sell
etym.南: a bell-shaped pot in the oldest graphs; nothing in it sounds like nán — know it from 南方 (nánfāng) and 南京 (Nánjīng)
etym.卡: 上 (shàng) and 下 (xià) welded into one — stuck in between; borrowed for the English word card: 信用卡 (xìnyòngkǎ)
etym.历: 厂 (a cliff overhang) sheltering 力 (lì), which gives the sound — the road already walked, and the calendar that counts it: history; to pass through. 历史 (lìshǐ), 经历 (jīnglì)
etym.去: a striding figure over 厶 (the mouth of a dwelling) in the old graph — someone stepping out and away: to go, to leave. 出去 (chūqù), 去年 (qùnián)
etym.参: a star-cluster graph gone abstract — to join in: 参加 (cānjiā)
etym.双: 又 (yòu, a hand) doubled — a pair of hands: a pair
etym.叔: 尗 (shū, beans on the vine — the sound) + 又 (a hand): the bean-picker; borrowed for father's younger brother. 叔叔 (shūshu)
etym.变: 亦 (yì) over 又 (yòu, a hand) — the hand that turns things over: to change. 变化 (biànhuà)
etym.句: 勹 (a hook wrapping) around 口 (kǒu, mouth) — a hooked-off length of speech: sentence. 句子 (jùzi)
etym.叫: 口 (kǒu, mouth) + 丩 (jiū, twisted cords, the sound side) — to call, to be named. 我叫 (wǒ jiào)...
etym.可: a mouth 口 (kǒu) letting a breath out — assent: may, can. 可以 (kěyǐ)
etym.号: 口 (a mouth) crying out + 丂 (kǎo), which hints the sound (kǎo→hào) — a call, then the number you answer to. 几号 (jǐ hào)
etym.吃: 口 (a mouth) + 乞 (qǐ, to beg), which hints the sound (qǐ→chī) — the mouth asking to be fed: to eat. 吃饭 (chīfàn), 好吃 (hǎochī)
etym.合: a lid closing onto 口 (kǒu, a mouth) — fitting together: to join. 合在一起 (hé zài yìqǐ)
etym.名: 夕 (xī, evening) + 口 (kǒu, mouth) — too dark to be seen, so you call your name out: name. 名字 (míngzi)
etym.向: a window under a roof in the old graph — the way the window faces: toward. 方向 (fāngxiàng)
etym.吗: 口 (the mouth radical, for spoken particles) + 马 (mǎ), which gives the sound — the tag that turns a sentence into a question. 你好吗 (nǐ hǎo ma)
etym.吧: 口 (the mouth radical, for spoken particles) + 巴 (bā), which gives the sound — the soft push at the end of a sentence: let's, I suppose
etym.听: 口 (kǒu, mouth) + 斤 (jīn, axe) — the ear of the old 聽 (tīng) is gone; picture leaning toward the sound of the axe: to listen
etym.吸: 口 (a mouth) drawing air in — to inhale. 及 (jí, to catch up) hints the sound (jí→xī). 呼吸 (hūxī)
etym.吹: 口 (kǒu, mouth) + 欠 (qiàn, a gaping mouth) — all breath: to blow. 吹牛 (chuīniú), inflating the ox
etym.员: 口 (kǒu, mouth) + 贝 (bèi, shell-money) — a mouth on the payroll: staff member. 服务员 (fúwùyuán)
etym.呢: 口 (kǒu, mouth) marks it as spoken noise, 尼 (ní) lends the sound — the trailing question particle: 你呢 (nǐ ne)?
etym.呼: 口 (a mouth) + 乎 (hū), which gives the sound — breath pushed out: to exhale, to call out. 呼吸 (hūxī)
etym.咋: 口 (the mouth radical) + 乍 (zhà), which hints the sound (zhà→zǎ) — dialect shorthand for 怎么 (zěnme): how. 咋样 (zǎyàng)
etym.和: 禾 (hé, grain — also gives the sound) + 口 (a mouth) — grain in every mouth, everyone at peace: and; harmony
etym.咖: 口 (kǒu, mouth) marks a borrowed sound, 加 (jiā) carries it — coined for coffee: 咖啡 (kāfēi)
etym.响: 口 (a mouth) + 向 (xiàng), which gives the sound (xiàng→xiǎng) — a sound that carries: to ring out; loud. 影响 (yǐngxiǎng)
etym.哥: 可 (kě) stacked twice — originally the song word (歌 (gē) kept that job); borrowed for big brother: 哥哥 (gēge)
etym.哪: 口 (the mouth radical) turning 那 (nà, that) into its question — which? 那 (nà) gives the sound (nà→nǎ). 哪儿 (nǎr)
etym.哭: two wailing mouths 口 (kǒu) over 犬 (quǎn, a dog) — howling: to cry
etym.唱: 口 (a mouth) + 昌 (chāng, two suns, bright), which gives the sound (chāng→chàng): to sing. 唱歌 (chànggē)
etym.商: a tall shopfront of a character — trade: 商店 (shāngdiàn), 商场 (shāngchǎng). The parts are stroke soup; learn the shape whole
etym.啊: 口 (the mouth radical, for spoken particles) + 阿 (ā), which gives the sound — the open-mouthed exclamation: ah. 是啊 (shì a)
etym.啡: 口 (the mouth radical) + 非 (fēi), which gives the sound — a syllable invented to spell coffee. 咖啡 (kāfēi)
etym.啤: 口 (kǒu, mouth) marks a borrowed sound, 卑 (bēi) carries it — coined to say beer: 啤酒 (píjiǔ)
etym.喂: 口 (a mouth) calling + 畏 (wèi), which gives the sound: hello?, hey — and to feed someone
etym.喜: 壴 (zhù, a drum) over 口 (kǒu, mouth) — drums and singing: joy, to like. 喜欢 (xǐhuan)
etym.喝: 口 (a mouth) + 曷 (hé), the sound side it shares with 渴 (kě, thirsty) — hé→hē: to drink. 喝茶 (hēchá)
etym.嘲: 口 (a mouth) + 朝 (cháo), which gives the sound — a mouth turned on someone: to mock. 嘲笑 (cháoxiào)
etym.嘴: 口 (kǒu, mouth) + 觜 (zuǐ, a beak) — the beak word, with the mouth radical added later: mouth
etym.器: four vessels 口 (kǒu) guarded by a 犬 (quǎn, dog) in the middle: utensil, instrument. 乐器 (yuèqì)
etym.回: 口 (kǒu) inside 口 (kǒu) — a path spiraling back on itself: to return
etym.因: 大 (dà, a person) stretched out on a 囗 (mat) — what everything rests on: the basis, because. 因为 (yīnwèi)
etym.园: 囗 (a walled enclosure) + 元 (yuán), which gives the sound — planted ground behind walls: a garden, a park. 公园 (gōngyuán)
etym.国: 囗 (walls) around 玉 (yù, jade), the ruler's seal: country
etym.图: 囗 (a frame) with 冬 (dōng) inside — your note: same 冬 (dōng) as 冬天 (dōngtiān); a mapped territory in its border
etym.地: 土 (tǔ, earth) + 也 (yě), an old sound-lender long since drifted (yě→dì): the ground, a place. 地方 (dìfang), 地铁 (dìtiě)
etym.场: 土 (tǔ, levelled earth) + the same right side as 汤 (tāng) and 杨 (yáng), its sound drifted to chǎng: open ground — a field, a market, a stage. 商场 (shāngchǎng), 操场 (cāochǎng)
etym.圾: 土 (tǔ, earth) + 及 (jí), which gives the sound (jí→jī) — only ever in 垃圾 (lājī), garbage; learn the word, not the parts
etym.坏: 土 (tǔ, earth) + 不 (bù, no) — ground you can't build on: bad. 好坏 (hǎo huài)
etym.坐: two 人 (rén, people) settled on the 土 (tǔ, ground) — to sit
etym.块: 土 (tǔ, earth) + 夬 (guài), which hints the sound (guài→kuài) — a broken-off lump: a piece; the spoken word for yuan. 块钱 (kuàiqián)
etym.垃: 土 (tǔ, earth) + 立 (lì) — only ever in 垃圾 (lājī), garbage; learn the word, not the parts
etym.城: 土 (tǔ, rammed-earth walls) + 成 (chéng), which gives the sound — the walled town: a city. 城市 (chéngshì)
etym.境: 土 (tǔ, the ground) + 竟 (jìng, the very end — also gives the sound): where the land runs out — a border; surroundings. 环境 (huánjìng)
etym.士: an axe-blade of office in the oldest graphs — a man of rank: a scholar, a gentleman. 十 (shí) happens to give the sound (shí→shì). 女士 (nǚshì)
etym.处: 夂 (a trailing foot) stopping at a stool (the 卜 (bǔ) shape, once 几 (jī)) — where you come to rest: a place; to deal with. 处所 (chùsuǒ)
etym.备: 夂 (a foot going out) to the 田 (tián, field) — gear laid out for the trip: to prepare. 准备 (zhǔnbèi)
etym.复: a foot going back over the road in the old graph — again, to repeat: 复习 (fùxí)
etym.外: 夕 (xī, evening) + 卜 (bǔ, divination) — divining at night, outside the proper hour: outside
etym.多: 夕 (xī, evening) doubled — evening after evening piling up: many
etym.大: a person standing with arms and legs thrown wide — big
etym.天: 一 (yī, one line) stretched over 大 (dà, a person, arms wide) — the line above everyone: the sky
etym.太: 大 (dà, big) with a dot below — big, and then some: too
etym.夫: 大 (dà, a grown man) with the topknot pin through his hair — a man of age: husband. 丈夫 (zhàngfu)
etym.夸: 大 (dà, big) + 亏 (kuī, loss — and nearly the sound) — talking big until it costs you: to exaggerate. 夸张 (kuāzhāng)
etym.奇: 大 (dà, big) perched astride 可 (kě) — someone sitting oddly tall: strange. 奇怪 (qíguài)
etym.奶: 女 (nǚ, woman) + 乃 (nǎi), which gives the sound — the milk-giver: milk; grandma. 奶奶 (nǎinai), 牛奶 (niúnǎi)
etym.她: 女 (nǚ, woman) + 也 (yě) — 他 (tā) rebuilt with the woman radical, a 1920s invention: she
etym.好: 女 (nǚ, woman) with 子 (zǐ, child) — a mother holding her child: good
etym.如: 女 (nǚ, woman) + 口 (kǒu, mouth) — doing as the word says, per the old books: as, if. 如果 (rúguǒ)
etym.妈: 女 (nǚ, woman) + 马 (mǎ), which gives the sound: mom. 妈妈 (māma)
etym.妹: 女 (nǚ, woman) + 未 (wèi, not-yet — it also hints the sound, wèi→mèi): the not-yet-grown one — younger sister. 妹妹 (mèimei)
etym.妻: a hand reaching into a woman's 女 (nǚ) hair to pin it up — the old marriage rite: wife. 妻子 (qīzi)
etym.始: 女 (nǚ, woman) + 台 (tái, the sound side — shǐ was closer long ago) — where everything begins: to start. 开始 (kāishǐ)
etym.姐: 女 (nǚ, woman) + 且 (qiě), which hints the sound (qiě→jiě): the elder sister. 姐姐 (jiějie), 小姐 (xiǎojiě)
etym.姓: 女 (nǚ, woman) + 生 (shēng, born) — the clan you are born to, through the mother; same sound-shift as 星 (xīng): surname
etym.姥: 女 (nǚ, woman) + 老 (lǎo, old — also gives the sound): the old woman — grandma on mother's side. 姥姥 (lǎolao)
etym.姨: 女 (nǚ, woman) + 夷 (yí), which gives the sound: mother's sister — auntie. 阿姨 (āyí)
etym.婚: 女 (nǚ, a bride) + 昏 (hūn, dusk — also gives the sound): weddings were held at nightfall — to marry. 结婚 (jiéhūn)
etym.孔: 子 (zǐ, child) + 乚 (a hook) — an opening: hole; and the sage's surname, 孔子 (Kǒngzǐ)
etym.字: 子 (zǐ, a child) under the 宀 (roof) — characters bred in the house, compound ones born from simple parts: a written character. 子 (zǐ) gives the sound (zǐ→zì). 名字 (míngzi)
etym.孙: 子 (zǐ, child) + 小 (xiǎo, small) — the child's child: grandchild. 孙子 (sūnzi)
etym.孝: the old-man top of 老 (lǎo) carried by 子 (zǐ, the child) below — the child bearing the elder: filial. 孝顺 (xiàoshùn)
etym.季: 禾 (hé, grain) + 子 (zǐ, child) — the harvest's youngest: the season's turn. 季节 (jìjié)
etym.孤: 子 (zǐ, child) + 瓜 (guā, the sound side, gū a step off guā) — a child alone: orphaned, lonely. 孤单 (gūdān)
etym.学: 子 (zǐ, child) under 冖 (a roof), sparks of knowledge falling from above: to study
etym.孩: 子 (zǐ, child) + 亥 (hài), which gives the sound (hài→hái): a child. 孩子 (háizi)
etym.它: 宀 (roof) + 匕 (bǐ) — originally a snake under the floor; the creature, not him or her: it
etym.安: 女 (nǚ, woman) under 宀 (a roof) — settled at home: peace. 安静 (ānjìng)
etym.完: 宀 (roof) + 元 (yuán, hints at wán) — the roof goes on last: finished
etym.官: a public hall under the 宀 (roof) — the one seated in it: official. 当官 (dāng guān)
etym.定: 宀 (roof) + a squashed 正 (zhèng, straight) — everything set straight under the roof: settled, fixed. 一定 (yídìng)
etym.宜: 且 (qiě) under 宀 (a roof) — meat laid on the altar-board originally: fitting, right; cheap in 便宜 (piányi)
etym.实: the old 實 (shí) was money under the 宀 (roof) — substance in the house: real, solid. 其实 (qíshí)
etym.客: someone under your roof (宀) — a guest. 各 (gè) nudges the sound: gè→kè. 客人 (kèrén), 游客 (yóukè)
etym.室: 宀 (a roof) + 至 (zhì, an arrow arriving) — the room you arrive into and stay: a chamber. 至 (zhì) hints the sound (zhì→shì). 教室 (jiàoshì), 办公室 (bàngōngshì)
etym.家: 宀 (roof) + 豕 (shǐ, pig) — a pig under your roof meant wealth: home
etym.容: 宀 (roof) + 谷 (gǔ, valley) — room enough for a valley under one roof: to hold, to allow. 容易 (róngyì)
etym.宾: 宀 (roof) + 兵 (bīng, nearly the sound) — the one received under your roof: guest. 宾馆 (bīnguǎn)
etym.对: 又 (yòu, a hand) + 寸 (cùn, the measure) — a hand answering to the measure: correct; toward
etym.少: 小 (xiǎo, small) shaved thinner by a stroke: few, less
etym.尤: a hand with a mark on it in the old graph — the one that stands out: especially. 尤其 (yóuqí)
etym.就: 京 (jīng, capital) + 尤 (yóu, especially) — making straight for the capital: then, right away
etym.层: 尸 (a house shell) + 云 (yún) — standing in for 曾 (céng), the true sound side of the old 層 (céng): a storey, a layer
etym.居: 尸 (a seated body) + 古 (gǔ), which hints the sound (gǔ→jū) — settled where you sit: to reside. 邻居 (línjū)
etym.岁: the stump of the old 歲 (suì) — the 山 (shān) and 夕 (xī) are just what's left: years of age. 几岁 (jǐ suì)?
etym.左: a hand laid over 工 (gōng, the work tool) — the hand that steadies while the right one works: left. 左边 (zuǒbiān)
etym.差: 羊 (yáng)-ish top + 工 (gōng, work) — work gone crooked: to differ, to fall short. 差 (chà)
etym.市: a market banner on its pole — the flag that marked market day: market, city. 超市 (chāoshì)
etym.师: a mound and a banner in the old graph — the army camped, then its drill-master: teacher. 老师 (lǎoshī)
etym.希: crossed threads over 布 (bù, cloth) — weave so sparse you see through it: rare; hence to hope. 希望 (xīwàng)
etym.带: a belt with straps hanging over cloth 巾 (jīn) — a belt; whatever hangs from it goes with you: to carry along
etym.帮: 巾 (cloth) + 邦 (bāng, a state — also gives the sound): originally the cloth sides that hold a shoe together — to help. 帮忙 (bāngmáng), 帮助 (bāngzhù)
etym.帽: 巾 (cloth) + 冒 (mào, eyes covered over — also gives the sound): the cloth that covers the head — a hat. 帽子 (màozi)
etym.平: a balance leveled off — flat, even. 水平 (shuǐpíng)
etym.床: 广 (a roof) + 木 (mù, wood) — the wooden thing under the roof: bed. 起床 (qǐchuáng)
etym.应: the stump of 應 (yīng) — the falcon answering the call: should; to respond. 应该 (yīnggāi)
etym.店: 广 (a lean-to roof) + 占 (zhàn, hints at diàn) — a stall pitched under a roof: shop. 商店 (shāngdiàn)
etym.座: 广 (a lean-to roof) over 坐 (zuò, to sit — also gives the sound): the sitting-place under the roof — a seat. 座位 (zuòwèi)
etym.康: grain sifting down under the 广 (roof) — full bins, good years: health. 健康 (jiànkāng)
etym.廊: 广 (a lean-to roof) + 郎 (láng), which gives the sound: a roofed walkway — corridor. 走廊 (zǒuláng)
etym.开: 一 (yī, the bar) and 廾 (two hands) lifting it off the door: to open
etym.张: 弓 (gōng, a bow) + 长 (zhǎng, to stretch — also gives the sound, zhǎng→zhāng): drawing a bow wide open — to spread; the measure word for flat things. 夸张 (kuāzhāng)
etym.当: the simplified rubble of 當 (dāng) — one field standing for another: to serve as. 当然 (dāngrán), of course
etym.影: 景 (jǐng, a scene in full light) + 彡 (trailing streaks) — what the light throws off: a shadow, an image. 景 (jǐng) hints the sound (jǐng→yǐng). 电影 (diànyǐng)
etym.往: 彳 (a step) + 主 (zhǔ, master) — stepping toward the master's place: to head toward. 我往你走 (wǒ wǎng nǐ zǒu)
etym.很: 彳 (the stepping radical) + 艮 (gěn), which hints the sound (gěn→hěn) — once stubborn, now just the intensifier: very. 很好 (hěn hǎo)
etym.得: 彳 (a step out on the road) + a hand closing on a found cowrie in the old graph — money picked up on the road: to get; then the grammar word de. 得到 (dédào), 觉得 (juéde)
etym.必: 心 (xīn, heart) with a stroke barred across it — the heart pinned down: must. 必须 (bìxū). A picture, not the real origin
etym.忘: 亡 (wáng, gone — also gives the sound, wáng→wàng) over 心 (xīn, the heart): gone from the heart — to forget. 忘记 (wàngjì)
etym.忙: 忄 (the heart, upright) + 亡 (wáng), which hints the sound (wáng→máng): the heart run off its feet — busy. 帮忙 (bāngmáng), 很忙 (hěn máng)
etym.快: 忄 (the heart) + 夬 (guài, breaking open), which hints the sound (guài→kuài): the heart let loose — fast; glad. 快乐 (kuàilè), 快递 (kuàidì)
etym.怎: 乍 (zhà, sudden) + 心 (xīn, heart) — the heart pulled up short: how? 怎么 (zěnme)
etym.怒: 奴 (nú, a slave — also gives the sound, nú→nù) over 心 (xīn, the heart): a heart pressed down until it bursts — rage. 路怒症 (lùnùzhèng)
etym.怕: 忄 (heart) + 白 (bái) — that family again: bái, bǎi, pà; fear drains you white. 害怕 (hàipà)
etym.思: the 田 (tián) up top was once 囟 (xìn), the skull — skull and 心 (xīn, heart) thinking together: 意思 (yìsi)
etym.急: a squashed 及 (jí), the sound side, over 心 (xīn, heart) — the heart racing: anxious. 着急 (zháojí)
etym.性: 忄 (heart) + 生 (shēng, born) — the heart you are born with: nature; same 生 (shēng) sound-shift as 姓 (xìng)
etym.怪: 忄 (heart) + 圣 (as written: a hand over dirt) — the heart prickling at it: strange. 奇怪 (qíguài)
etym.恨: 忄 (the heart) + 艮 (gěn), which hints the sound (gěn→hèn): the heart dug in and unmoving — to hate, to resent
etym.息: 自 (zì, a nose) over 心 (xīn, the heart) — breath drawn down to the heart: to rest; a breath. 休息 (xiūxi)
etym.您: 你 (nǐ, you) set over 心 (xīn, heart) — you, taken to heart: the polite you. 您好 (nín hǎo)
etym.情: 忄 (the heart) + 青 (qīng), which gives the sound (qīng→qíng): what the heart holds — feeling. 事情 (shìqing), 感情 (gǎnqíng)
etym.惯: 忄 (the heart) + 贯 (guàn, coins strung on one cord — also gives the sound): the heart running along its string — habit, used to. 习惯 (xíguàn)
etym.想: 相 (xiāng, looking something over — also gives the sound, xiāng→xiǎng) with 心 (xīn, the heart) underneath: an image held over the heart — to think of, to want. 想要 (xiǎngyào), 思想 (sīxiǎng)
etym.意: 音 (yīn, sound) + 心 (xīn, heart) — the sound the heart makes: meaning, intention
etym.感: 咸 (xián, hints at gǎn) + 心 (xīn, heart) — what lands on the heart: to feel. 感冒 (gǎnmào), 感情 (gǎnqíng)
etym.愿: 原 (yuán, the source — also gives the sound, yuán→yuàn) over 心 (xīn, the heart): what wells up from the heart's spring — a wish; willing. 愿意 (yuànyi)
etym.慢: 忄 (the heart) + 曼 (màn, drawn long — also gives the sound): the heart taking its time — slow
etym.懂: 忄 (the heart) + 董 (dǒng, to oversee — also gives the sound): the heart in charge of the matter — to understand
etym.戏: 又 (a hand) + 戈 (gē, halberd) — stage-fighting with a prop spear: a play, a game. 游戏 (yóuxì)
etym.成: an axe-blade graph, finished in one casting — to become, to complete. 完成 (wánchéng)
etym.或: 戈 (gē, a halberd) guarding 口 (kǒu, a walled town) — the old word for 国 (guó); borrowed for or. 或者 (huòzhě)
etym.户: one leaf of the double door 门 (mén) — a single door: a household. 户口 (hùkǒu)
etym.房: 户 (hù, a single door-leaf) + 方 (fāng), which gives the sound (fāng→fáng): the rooms behind one door — a house, a room. 房子 (fángzi), 房间 (fángjiān)
etym.所: 戶 (hù, a door) + 斤 (jīn, an axe) — where the work happens: a place; 所以 (suǒyǐ), therefore
etym.打: 扌 (hand) + 丁 (dīng, nail) — a hand driving a nail: to hit
etym.托: 扌 (a hand) held flat + 乇 (tuō, a blade of grass — here the sound): carried on the open palm — to hold up; to entrust. 托儿所 (tuō'érsuǒ)
etym.扫: 扌 (hand) + 彐 (a broom in hand) — sweeping: 打扫 (dǎsǎo)
etym.扬: 扌 (a hand) tossing grain to the wind — to raise, to spread. The right side is the sound it shares with 杨 (yáng). 表扬 (biǎoyáng)
etym.扰: 扌 (hand) + 尤 (yóu, a stand-in sound side from the old 擾 (rǎo)) — a hand poking in: to disturb. 请勿打扰 (qǐng wù dǎrǎo)
etym.找: 扌 (hand) + 戈 (gē, halberd) — a hand patting around for the spear it put down: to look for
etym.把: 扌 (a hand) + 巴 (bā), which gives the sound (bā→bǎ): the hand's grip — to grasp; the word that moves the object up front
etym.折: 扌 (hand) + 斤 (jīn, axe) — an axe in hand: to snap, to fold; a discount, 打折 (dǎzhé)
etym.护: 扌 (a hand) + 户 (hù, a door — also gives the sound): a hand barring the door — to protect. 护照 (hùzhào)
etym.抱: 扌 (a hand) + 包 (bāo, to wrap — also gives the sound, bāo→bào): arms wrapped around — to hug. 拥抱 (yōngbào)
etym.担: 扌 (a hand) + 旦 (dàn), which gives the sound (dàn→dān): a load taken on the shoulder — to carry; to shoulder a worry. 担心 (dānxīn)
etym.拥: 扌 (a hand) + 用 (yòng), which gives the sound (yòng→yōng): arms full — to embrace; to crowd in. 拥抱 (yōngbào)
etym.拿: 合 (hé, to close) + 手 (shǒu, hand) — a hand closing around something: to take
etym.指: 扌 (the hand) + 旨 (zhǐ, the point of a decree — also gives the sound): the pointing part of the hand — a finger; to point. 手指头 (shǒuzhǐtou)
etym.按: 扌 (a hand) + 安 (ān, settled — also gives the sound, ān→àn): a hand pressing something still — to press. 按摩 (ànmó)
etym.换: 扌 (a hand) + 奂 (huàn), which gives the sound: one hand gives while the other takes — to exchange
etym.据: 扌 (a hand) + 居 (jū, to settle — also gives the sound, jū→jù): what the hand rests its weight on — a basis; according to. 根据 (gēnjù)
etym.接: 扌 (a hand) + 妾 (qiè), which hints the sound (qiè→jiē): hand meeting hand — to receive; to pick someone up. 接收 (jiēshōu)
etym.提: 扌 (a hand) + 是 (shì), which hints the sound (shì→tí, the same lend as in 题 (tí)): lifting by the handle — to carry; to bring up. 提高 (tígāo)
etym.搬: 扌 (hands) + 般 (bān, a boat poled about — also gives the sound): shifting things bodily — to move. 搬家 (bānjiā)
etym.摩: 麻 (má, hemp — nearly the sound too) + 手 (shǒu, hand) — hands working the fibers: to rub. 按摩 (ànmó)
etym.操: 扌 (a hand) + 喿 (zào, birds clamoring in a tree), which hints the sound (zào→cāo): hands drilled through their motions — to drill, to handle. 操场 (cāochǎng)
etym.收: 丩 (jiū, twisted cords) + 攵 (a tapping hand) — cords gathered into the hand: to receive. 收到 (shōudào)
etym.攻: 工 (gōng, which gives the sound) + 攵 (a hand swinging a stick): work done by striking — to attack. 攻打 (gōngdǎ), 攻略 (gōnglüè)
etym.放: 方 (fāng, which gives the sound: fāng→fàng) + 攵 (a hand swinging a stick): driving the herd out to pasture — to let go, to put. 放心 (fàngxīn), 放学 (fàngxué)
etym.故: 古 (gǔ, long ago — also gives the sound, gǔ→gù) + 攵 (a striking hand): what made things happen back then — a cause; old; a tale. 故事 (gùshi)
etym.教: 孝 (xiào, a child honoring the old), which hints the sound (xiào→jiào), + 攵 (a hand with a rod): the rod and the lesson — to teach. 教室 (jiàoshì)
etym.散: hemp beaten apart with the 攵 (tapping hand) — bits flying: to scatter. 散步 (sànbù), a walk
etym.数: 攵 (a hand tapping) + 娄 (lóu, hints at shù) — counting off: number shù, count shǔ
etym.文: a figure with patterns tattooed on the chest — marks, then writing: 中文 (Zhōngwén), 课文 (kèwén)
etym.料: 米 (mǐ, rice) + 斗 (dǒu, a dipper) — grain measured by the scoop: ingredients, material. 饮料 (yǐnliào)
etym.斧: 父 (fù, father — also gives the sound, fù→fǔ) over 斤 (jīn, an axe): the axe itself. 斧头 (fǔtou)
etym.新: 斤 (jīn, an axe) at fresh-cut wood — new. 亲 (qīn) hints the sound (qīn→xīn). 新年 (xīnnián), 新鲜 (xīnxiān)
etym.方: picture a flag on a bent pole marking a direction — 北方 (běifāng), 地方 (dìfang). The strokes themselves tell no story
etym.旁: 方 (fāng) at the base — the real sound side, fāng to páng — off to one side: beside. 旁边 (pángbiān)
etym.无: the old 無 (wú) was a dancer with long sleeves; simplified down to almost nothing — which is what it means: without. 无聊 (wúliáo)
etym.旧: 丨 (a stick) leaning by 日 (rì, the sun) — one day gone by after another: old, worn
etym.早: 日 (rì, sun) just above 十 (shí, the first sprout) — the sun barely up: early
etym.时: 日 (rì, sun) + 寸 (cùn, inch) — the sun creeping forward inch by inch: time
etym.明: 日 (rì, sun) + 月 (yuè, moon) — the two bright things in the sky: bright
etym.易: 日 (rì, sun) over 勿 (wù) — originally a lizard changing its color: change, hence easy. 容易 (róngyì)
etym.星: 日 (rì, sun) + 生 (shēng, hints at xīng) — sparks born of the sun: star. 星期 (xīngqī)
etym.昨: 日 (rì, sun) + 乍 (zhà) — the sound side it shares with 作 (zuò): yesterday
etym.是: 日 (rì, sun) over a squashed 正 (zhèng, straight) — straight under the sun: to be, yes
etym.晚: 日 (rì, sun) + 免 (miǎn, hints at wǎn) — the sun excused for the day: evening
etym.晴: 日 (rì, the sun) + 青 (qīng, that clear blue-green — also gives the sound, qīng→qíng): the sky rinsed clear — fine weather. 晴天 (qíngtiān)
etym.更: one watch of the night giving way to the next — to change over; even more. 更 (gèng)
etym.替: two 夫 (fū, men) over 日 (rì, the day) — one stepping into the other's shift: to substitute. 替补 (tìbǔ)
etym.最: 曰 (yuē, say) + 取 (qǔ, take) — taking the final say: the most
etym.朋: two strings of shells hung side by side in the old graph — paired: friend. 朋友 (péngyou)
etym.服: 月 (an old boat squeezed thin) + a hand pressing a kneeling figure — pressed into service: to serve, to submit; what the body is fitted into — clothes. 衣服 (yīfu), 舒服 (shūfu)
etym.望: 亡 (wáng) + 月 (yuè, moon) — that family again (máng, wàng, wǎng): gazing moonward for what is gone: to hope. 希望 (xīwàng)
etym.期: 其 (qí, which gives the sound: qí→qī) + 月 (yuè, the moon): time counted in moons — a set period, a date. 星期 (xīngqī)
etym.朵: a bloom nodding on the 木 (mù, tree) — the measure for flowers and ears: 耳朵 (ěrduo)
etym.机: 木 (mù, wood) + 几 (jǐ, a small table — also gives the sound, jǐ→jī): the wooden loom, the pivot where things turn — a machine; a chance. 手机 (shǒujī), 机会 (jīhuì)
etym.李: 木 (mù, a tree) + 子 (zǐ, children — it also hints the sound, zǐ→lǐ): the tree hung with children, plums — plum; the surname Li. 行李箱 (xínglixiāng)
etym.村: 木 (mù, trees) + 寸 (cùn, which gives the sound: cùn→cūn): a huddle of trees and houses — a village. 农村人 (nóngcūn rén)
etym.条: a long whippy branch off the tree 木 (mù) — the measure word for long thin things: 面条 (miàntiáo)
etym.杯: 木 (mù, wood) + 不 (bù, the rough sound side) — a wooden cup: 杯子 (bēizi)
etym.板: 木 (mù, wood) + 反 (fǎn), which hints the sound (fǎn→bǎn): wood split flat — a plank, a board. 黑板 (hēibǎn)
etym.极: 木 (mù, wood) + 及 (jí, to reach — also gives the sound): the ridgepole, the beam nothing sits above — the utmost. 极了 (jíle)
etym.林: 木 (mù, tree) + 木 (mù, tree) — trees doubled: woods. 树林 (shùlín)
etym.果: fruit drawn round on a 木 (mù, tree) — the 田 (tián)-looking top is the fruit, not a field: fruit. 水果 (shuǐguǒ)
etym.查: 木 (mù, wood) + 旦 (dàn, dawn) — going over the timber at first light: to inspect. 检查 (jiǎnchá)
etym.树: 木 (mù, tree) + 对 (duì) — it stands where 尌 (shù), the old sound side, used to be: tree
etym.校: 木 (mù, timber) + 交 (jiāo, crossing — it hints the sound, jiāo→xiào): a yard fenced with crossed timbers — the school. 学校 (xuéxiào), 校长 (xiàozhǎng)
etym.样: 木 (mù, wood) + 羊 (yáng), which gives the sound (yáng→yàng): the carpenter's wooden pattern — appearance, kind, way. 一样 (yíyàng), 怎样 (zěnyàng)
etym.根: 木 (mù, a tree) + 艮 (gěn, dug-in — also gives the sound, gěn→gēn): the part that grips the ground — a root; a basis. 根据 (gēnjù)
etym.格: 木 (mù, wood) + 各 (gè), which gives the sound (gè→gé): a wooden lattice — squares to fill in: a standard, a form. 表格 (biǎogé)
etym.桌: 卓 (zhuó, high) grown a 木 (mù, wood) base — the raised board: table. 桌子 (zhuōzi)
etym.梯: 木 (mù, wood) + 弟 (dì, younger brother, the one next in order — it hints the sound, dì→tī): rungs in order like brothers by age — a ladder. 电梯 (diàntī)
etym.检: 木 (mù, wood — once the sealed lid on a document box) + 佥 (qiān), which hints the sound (qiān→jiǎn): opening the box to look — to inspect. 检查 (jiǎnchá)
etym.森: three 木 (mù, trees) — woods too deep to see out of: 森林 (sēnlín)
etym.椅: 木 (mù, wood) + 奇 (qí), which hints the sound (qí→yǐ): wood built to lean into — a chair. 椅子 (yǐzi)
etym.楚: two 木 (mù, trees) over 疋 (pǐ) — an old thorn-bush word surviving in 清楚 (qīngchu), clear
etym.楼: 木 (mù, timber) + 娄 (lóu), which gives the sound: timber stacked storey on storey — a building; a floor
etym.次: two strokes + 欠 (qiàn, a yawning mouth) — pausing for breath: a stop, hence a time. 一次 (yícì)
etym.欢: 又 (a hand) + 欠 (qiàn, an open mouth) — head thrown back mid-cheer: joy, to like
etym.款: 士 (shì) over 示 (shì), beside 欠 (qiàn, owing) — what is owed, spelled out: a sum. 贷款 (dàikuǎn)
etym.歌: 哥 (gē, which gives the sound) + 欠 (a figure with mouth open, breath leaving): breath shaped into tune — a song. 唱歌 (chànggē)
etym.正: 一 (yī, the line) + 止 (zhǐ, a foot) — a foot stopping exactly at the line: upright, exactly. 正在 (zhèngzài)
etym.步: two feet, one planted, one stepping — a step: 跑步 (pǎobù)
etym.死: 歹 (stripped bones) + 匕 (bǐ, a person bowed low) — the living kneeling over what remains: to die. 死亡 (sǐwáng)
etym.毒: rank growth over 母 (mǔ, mother) — the herb that mothers too much: poison. 病毒 (bìngdú)
etym.气: wisps of rising vapor — breath, air: 天气 (tiānqì), and the temper in 生气 (shēngqì)
etym.水: a stream down the middle with drops flying off — water itself, a picture
etym.求: a fur coat drawn whole — the original 裘 (qiú), begged for when winter came: to seek. 要求 (yāoqiú)
etym.汉: 氵 (water) — the Han river first, then the people named after it: 汉语 (Hànyǔ). The 又 (yòu) is all that survived of the old right side
etym.汽: 氵 (water) + 气 (qì, breath, air — also gives the sound): water gone to vapor — steam. 公共汽车 (gōnggòngqìchē)
etym.没: 氵 (water) + 殳 (a hand with a pole) — pushed under the water: sunk, gone; hence 没有 (méiyǒu), not have
etym.河: 氵 (water) + 可 (kě), which hints the sound (kě→hé): the big northern river first, then any river. 黄河 (Huáng Hé)
etym.法: 氵 (water) + 去 (qù, to go) — the law goes level as water: law, method. 办法 (bànfǎ)
etym.注: 氵 (water) + 主 (zhǔ), which gives the sound (zhǔ→zhù): water poured onto one point — to pour; to fix attention. 注意 (zhùyì)
etym.泳: 氵 (water) + 永 (yǒng, long-flowing — also gives the sound): the long stroke through water — to swim. 游泳 (yóuyǒng)
etym.洗: 氵 (water) + 先 (xiān, hints at xǐ) — water first: to wash. 洗手间 (xǐshǒujiān)
etym.清: 氵 (water) + 青 (qīng, that clear blue-green — also gives the sound): water you can see the bottom through — clear. 清楚 (qīngchu), 清水 (qīngshuǐ)
etym.渴: 氵 (water) + 曷 (hé), which hints the sound (hé→kě): wanting water — thirsty
etym.游: moving through water (氵) — swimming, roaming; a traveler flows. 斿 (yóu) gives the sound. 游泳 (yóuyǒng), 旅游 (lǚyóu)
etym.滑: 氵 (water) + 骨 (gǔ, bone) — wet and bone-smooth: slippery. 滑雪 (huáxuě)
etym.漂: 氵 (water) + 票 (piào), which gives the sound: carried along on the current — to float. 漂亮 (piàoliang), pretty
etym.演: 氵 (water) + 寅 (yín), which hints the sound (yín→yǎn): water spreading long and thin — to unfold, to perform. 表演 (biǎoyǎn)
etym.澡: 氵 (water) + 喿 (zào, birds clamoring — it gives the sound, zào→zǎo): water and splashing noise — a bath. 洗澡 (xǐzǎo)
etym.火: flames licking up around a center — fire, the picture itself. 火车 (huǒchē)
etym.灯: 火 (huǒ, fire) + 丁 (dīng), which hints the sound (dīng→dēng): a flame set up on a stand — a lamp
etym.点: 灬 (fire) + 占 (zhān, hints at diǎn) — sparks landing as little dots
etym.烧: 火 (huǒ, fire) + 尧 (yáo), which hints the sound (yáo→shāo): flame climbing high — to burn; a fever. 发烧 (fāshāo)
etym.热: 执 (zhí, to grip) + 灬 (fire) — holding something over the fire: hot
etym.然: flesh and a dog over 灬 (fire) — roasting: so, thus; the old form of 燃 (rán)
etym.照: 昭 (zhāo, bright — also gives the sound, zhāo→zhào) over 灬 (a bed of flames): light thrown onto something — to shine; a photograph. 照片 (zhàopiàn), 护照 (hùzhào)
etym.熊: 能 (néng) — itself originally the bear pictograph — over 灬 (its paws): bear. 熊猫 (xióngmāo)
etym.爬: 爪 (zhǎo, a claw) + 巴 (bā), which hints the sound (bā→pá): claws gripping the slope — to climb, to crawl. 爬山 (páshān)
etym.爱: the old 愛 (ài) had a 心 (xīn, heart) in the middle; the simplified form swapped it for 友 (yǒu, friend) — love
etym.父: a hand holding the axe (or the rod) — the father: 父亲 (fùqīn)
etym.爷: 父 (fù, father) on top — the old 爺 (yé) had 耶 (yé) below it for sound: grandpa. 爷爷 (yéye)
etym.爸: 父 (fù, father) + 巴 (bā), which gives the sound: dad. 爸爸 (bàba)
etym.牧: 牛 (niú, an ox) + 攵 (a hand swinging a stick) — driving the herd: to herd, to graze. 牧场 (mùchǎng)
etym.物: 牛 (niú, an ox — the old measure of what you owned) + 勿 (wù), which gives the sound: things. 动物 (dòngwù), 礼物 (lǐwù)
etym.特: 牛 (niú, bull) + 寺 (sì, court) — the bull picked out from the herd for the rite: special. 特别 (tèbié)
etym.狂: 犭 (dog) + 王 (wáng, the rough sound side) — a dog that thinks it is king: mad. 疯狂 (fēngkuáng)
etym.狗: 犭 (dog) + 句 (jù — read gōu in old texts, the sound side): dog
etym.狠: 犭 (a dog) + 艮 (gěn), which hints the sound (gěn→hěn): a dog that will not let go — ruthless, fierce
etym.独: 犭 (dog) + 虫 (chóng) — it stands in for 蜀 (shǔ), the old sound side of 獨 (dú): alone. 孤独 (gūdú)
etym.猛: 犭 (a dog) + 孟 (mèng, the firstborn — it gives the sound, mèng→měng): the strongest of the litter — fierce. 猛虎 (měnghǔ)
etym.猜: 犭 (dog) + 青 (qīng, the usual sound-lender, drifted far here) — a dog sniffing at the answer: to guess
etym.猫: 犭 (animal) + 苗 (miáo, the sound side — māo a whisker off miáo) — the animal that mews: cat
etym.献: 南 (nán — once a sacrificial vessel) + 犬 (quǎn, dog) — the offering brought forward: to donate. 贡献 (gòngxiàn)
etym.玩: 王 (jade) + 元 (yuán, hints at wán) — turning a piece of jade over in your hands: to play. 玩儿 (wánr)
etym.环: 王 (jade) + 不 (bù) — what is left of 睘 (huán), the sound side of the old 環 (huán): a jade ring. 环境 (huánjìng)
etym.现: 王 (the jade radical) + 见 (jiàn, to see — it hints the sound, jiàn→xiàn): jade's shine, there the moment you look — to appear; the present. 现在 (xiànzài), 发现 (fāxiàn)
etym.班: two 王 (wáng, jade) with a knife between — jade split into shares: class, shift
etym.球: 王 (the jade radical) + 求 (qiú, which gives the sound): a polished jade sphere — a ball. 足球 (zúqiú), 篮球 (lánqiú)
etym.理: 王 (the jade radical) + 里 (lǐ, which gives the sound): working jade along its natural veins — reason, order; to manage. 经理 (jīnglǐ)
etym.瓶: 瓦 (wǎ, fired clay) + 并 (bìng), which hints the sound (bìng→píng): a clay vessel with a neck — a bottle. 瓶子 (píngzi)
etym.甜: 舌 (shé, tongue) + 甘 (gān, sweetness) — your note: tongue on the left, sweet on the right: sweet
etym.用: a bucket put to work, by the oldest guesses — to use. 不用 (bú yòng), no need
etym.电: lightning forking down through the cloud of the old 電 (diàn): electricity. A picture, not a formula
etym.男: 田 (tián, field) + 力 (lì, strength) — strength in the field: male
etym.画: a hand drawing the boundary around 田 (tián, the field) — to draw: 画 (huà)
etym.界: 田 (tián, fields) + 介 (jiè, standing between — also gives the sound): the line drawn between fields — a boundary; the world inside it. 世界 (shìjiè)
etym.留: settled on the 田 (tián, field) — staying on: to remain. 留学 (liúxué), staying abroad to study
etym.略: 田 (tián, field) + 各 (gè) — the sound side it shares with 路 (lù); pacing out fields, scheming: strategy. 攻略 (gōnglüè)
etym.疯: 疒 (the sickbed radical) + 风 (fēng, wind — also gives the sound): the sickness that blows in like wind — mad. 疯狂 (fēngkuáng)
etym.疼: 疒 (sickness) + 冬 (dōng, winter) — the ache winter brings; your note: téng, not tòng — 痛 (tòng) is the other one
etym.病: 疒 (a figure laid out on the sickbed) + 丙 (bǐng), which gives the sound (bǐng→bìng): illness. 生病 (shēngbìng), 看病 (kànbìng)
etym.症: 疒 (the sickbed radical) + 正 (zhèng, exactly — also gives the sound): the exact shape an illness takes — a symptom, an -itis. 路怒症 (lùnùzhèng)
etym.瘦: 疒 (the sickbed radical) + 叟 (sǒu, an old man), which hints the sound (sǒu→shòu): illness-thin — skinny
etym.百: 白 (bái, which gives the sound: bái→bǎi) capped with 一 (yī, one stroke) — the mark that turned white into a hundred. 一百 (yìbǎi)
etym.的: 白 (bái) + 勺 (sháo) — your family note: here the 白 (bái) sound has drifted away entirely; the everywhere-particle
etym.盘: 舟 (zhōu, a boat) sailing on the 皿 (mǐn, dish) — food's ferry: plate. 盘子 (pánzi)
etym.直: an eye 目 (mù) with a straight sight-line above it — looking dead ahead: straight. 一直 (yìzhí)
etym.相: 木 (mù, tree) + 目 (mù, eye) — an eye sizing up a tree: mutual; looks (xiàng)
etym.看: a hand shading the 目 (mù, eye) — peering into the distance: to look
etym.真: stroke-shifted past its story — anchor it in 认真 (rènzhēn): true, really
etym.眼: 目 (mù, eye) + 艮 (gèn) — the sound side of your 很 (hěn) family, drifted to yǎn: eye. 眼睛 (yǎnjing)
etym.着: a sheep 羊 (yáng) held in the 目 (mù, eye) — a gaze that stays put: the -ing particle
etym.睛: 目 (mù, the eye) + 青 (qīng), which hints the sound (qīng→jīng): the black of the eye — the eyeball. 眼睛 (yǎnjing)
etym.睡: 目 (mù, the eye) + 垂 (chuí, to droop — it hints the sound, chuí→shuì): eyelids coming down — to sleep. 睡觉 (shuìjiào)
etym.知: 矢 (shǐ, arrow) + 口 (kǒu, mouth) — an answer leaving the mouth straight as an arrow: to know. 知道 (zhīdào)
etym.短: 矢 (shǐ, arrow) + 豆 (dòu, a stemmed dish) — both short things, both once used to measure: short
etym.矮: 矢 (shǐ, arrow) + 委 (wěi) — measured against an arrow and coming up short: short. 矮 (ǎi)
etym.碗: 石 (shí, stone) + 宛 (wǎn, curled around — also gives the sound): a vessel hollowed like a cupped hand — a bowl
etym.礼: 礻 (altar) + 乚 (a hook) — the hook is all that survived of 豊 (lǐ), the ritual vessel, and its sound: rites, gift. 礼物 (lǐwù)
etym.神: 礻 (the altar radical) + 申 (shēn, lightning in the old graph — also gives the sound, shēn→shén): what strikes from the sky at the altar — a god, a spirit. 神仙 (shénxiān), 神奇 (shénqí)
etym.票: 覀 (a cover) over 示 (shì) — originally flames flying up; now the paper that flies from hand to hand: ticket
etym.禁: 林 (lín, a grove — it hints the sound, lín→jìn) over 示 (shì, an altar): the sacred grove no one may enter — to forbid. 禁止 (jìnzhǐ)
etym.离: the top of an old bird-snare graph, stroke soup now — just know 离开 (líkāi), to leave, and 离 (lí), apart from
etym.秋: 禾 (hé, grain) + 火 (huǒ, fire) — stubble burned after harvest: autumn. 秋天 (qiūtiān)
etym.种: 禾 (hé, grain on the stalk) + 中 (zhōng), which gives the sound (zhōng→zhǒng): seed for the field — a kind; to plant
etym.秘: 禾 (hé, grain) + 必 (bì), which hints the sound (bì→mì) — written with the altar radical originally: what the spirits keep hidden — secret. 秘书 (mìshū)
etym.租: 禾 (hé, grain) + 且 (qiě) — grain paid to the landlord; the same rough sound side as 助 (zhù): rent. 出租车 (chūzūchē)
etym.空: 穴 (a cave mouth) + 工 (gōng), which hints the sound (gōng→kōng): the hollow inside — empty; the sky; spare time. 空调 (kōngtiáo)
etym.穿: 穴 (xué, a hole) + 牙 (yá, tooth) — a tooth gnawing through: to pierce; hence to put clothes on. 穿衣服 (chuān yīfu)
etym.突: 犬 (quǎn, a dog) bolting out of 穴 (xué, a hole) — out of nowhere: suddenly. 突然 (tūrán)
etym.站: 立 (lì, standing) + 占 (zhàn, to hold a spot — also gives the sound): to stand; where everything stands still — a station. 火车站 (huǒchēzhàn), 站起来 (zhàn qǐlai)
etym.竟: 音 (yīn, a tune) over 儿 (ér, legs) — the music played through to the end: finally; to one's surprise, 竟然 (jìngrán)
etym.笑: 竹 (zhú, bamboo) swaying over 夭 (yāo, a person tilting) — doubled over like bamboo in wind: to laugh. Not the real origin, but it sticks
etym.笔: 竹 (zhú, bamboo) + 毛 (máo, hair) — a bamboo shaft tipped with hair: writing brush
etym.笼: 竹 (zhú, bamboo) + 龙 (lóng, a dragon — it gives the sound): bamboo woven around something alive — a cage; a steamer. 笼子 (lóngzi)
etym.等: 竹 (zhú, bamboo) + 寺 (sì, temple) — cooling your heels at the temple gate: to wait
etym.答: 竹 (zhú, bamboo) + 合 (hé, to fit) — the reply on a bamboo slip that fits the question: to answer. 回答 (huídá)
etym.筷: 竹 (zhú, bamboo) + 快 (kuài, quick — it gives the sound): boatmen renamed the old 'stalled' word to its lucky opposite — chopsticks. 筷子 (kuàizi)
etym.简: 竹 (zhú, bamboo) + 间 (jiān), which gives the sound (jiān→jiǎn): the bamboo slips books were written on — brief, simple. 简单 (jiǎndān)
etym.箱: 竹 (zhú, bamboo) + 相 (xiāng), which gives the sound: a woven bamboo chest — a box, a trunk. 冰箱 (bīngxiāng), 行李箱 (xínglixiāng)
etym.篮: 竹 (zhú, bamboo) + 监 (jiān, the sound side it shares with 蓝 (lán)) — a woven basket: 篮球 (lánqiú)
etym.糕: 米 (mǐ, rice) + 羔 (gāo, a lamb — here just the sound): rice-flour cake. 蛋糕 (dàngāo)
etym.系: a hand holding threads of 糸 (mì, silk) — things tied together: a system, a relation. 没关系 (méi guānxi)
etym.累: 田 (tián, field) + 糸 (mì, silk) — your note: field work, then thread work: tired
etym.红: 纟 (silk) + 工 (gōng), which hints the sound (gōng→hóng): silk dyed the wedding color — red. 红色 (hóngsè)
etym.级: 纟 (silk threads) + 及 (jí, to reach — also gives the sound): threads graded step above step — a rank, a grade. 年级 (niánjí), 超级 (chāojí)
etym.纪: 纟 (silk) + 己 (jǐ), which gives the sound (jǐ→jì): the master thread that orders the whole skein — an era, a record; discipline. 年纪 (niánjì)
etym.纸: 纟 (silk fibres) + 氏 (shì), which hints the sound (shì→zhǐ): waste fibres matted and pressed flat — paper. 报纸 (bàozhǐ)
etym.终: 纟 (a thread) + 冬 (dōng, winter, the year's last season — it hints the sound, dōng→zhōng): the knot at the thread's end — to end; finally. 终于 (zhōngyú)
etym.绍: 纟 (silk) + 召 (zhào, to summon — it hints the sound, zhào→shào): tying one thread onto another — to connect: to introduce. 介绍 (jièshào)
etym.经: 纟 (silk) for the warp, the threads that run the loom's whole length; the right side carries the sound it shares with 轻 (qīng) — to run through: already, constantly. 已经 (yǐjīng), 经常 (jīngcháng)
etym.结: 纟 (silk) + 吉 (jí, hints at jié) — threads tied off: to knot, to conclude. 结婚 (jiéhūn), 中国结 (zhōngguójié)
etym.给: 纟 (silk) + 合 (hé, join) — threads brought together and handed over: to give
etym.绩: 纟 (silk) + 责 (zé, hints at jì) — thread spun up into cloth: results on the record. 成绩 (chéngjì)
etym.绿: 纟 (silk) + 录 (lù, the sound side — lǜ a shade off lù) — freshly dyed thread: green. 绿茶 (lǜchá)
etym.网: a net drawn as a frame with crossed cords — the net itself: 上网 (shàngwǎng), 网球 (wǎngqiú)
etym.羊: horns, ears and muzzle head-on — the sheep itself. 羊肉 (yángròu)
etym.美: 羊 (yáng, sheep) + 大 (dà, big) — a big sheep was beauty to a herder: beautiful. 美国 (Měiguó)
etym.羽: two wings side by side — feathers. 羽毛球 (yǔmáoqiú), the feathered ball
etym.翻: 羽 (yǔ, wings) + 番 (fān, a turn — also gives the sound): wings flipping over — to turn over; to translate. 翻唱 (fānchàng)
etym.老: a long-haired elder leaning on a stick 匕 (bǐ) — a pictograph; nothing sounds it out: old
etym.考: 耂 (the old-man radical) + 丂 (kǎo, which gives the sound): originally the old father himself; borrowed for putting people to the question — to test. 考试 (kǎoshì), 思考 (sīkǎo)
etym.者: an old sign with a muddled history — pure grammar glue now: the one who. 或者 (huòzhě)
etym.而: a beard drawn hanging from a jaw — loaned out as grammar glue long ago: and. 而且 (érqiě)
etym.聊: 耳 (ěr, ear) + 卯 (mǎo, the old sound side) — an ear lent out, hours slipping by: to chat. 聊天 (liáotiān)
etym.聪: 耳 (ěr, the ear) + 总 (zǒng), which hints the sound (zǒng→cōng): ears that catch everything — clever. 聪明 (cōngming)
etym.肾: 又 (a hand) over 月 (flesh) — rubble of 腎 (shèn): the kidney. 肾病 (shènbìng)
etym.胎: 月 (the flesh radical) + 台 (tái), which gives the sound: flesh just forming — the womb, an embryo; a tyre. 备胎 (bèitāi)
etym.胖: 月 (flesh) + 半 (bàn, half — and it nearly sounds it) — an extra half of flesh: fat. 胖 (pàng)
etym.胡: 月 (flesh) + 古 (gǔ, the sound side, gǔ to hú) — the jowl it named grows the beard: 胡须 (húxū)
etym.脑: 月 (flesh) + a crosshatched skull-top — the meat in your head: brain. 电脑 (diànnǎo), the electric brain
etym.脚: 月 (flesh) + 却 (què, lending a rough sound) — your note: it has 去 (qù) in the middle, going somewhere: foot
etym.脸: 月 (flesh) + 佥 (qiān) — the sound side it shares with 检 (jiǎn) and 验 (yàn): the face. 丢脸 (diūliǎn)
etym.腔: 月 (flesh) + 空 (kōng, hollow) — a hollow in the body: cavity; a manner of speech, 开黄腔 (kāi huángqiāng)
etym.腿: 月 (the flesh radical) + 退 (tuì, to step back — also gives the sound, tuì→tuǐ): the limb that does the stepping — the leg
etym.舌: the tongue drawn sticking out of 口 (kǒu, the mouth) — tongue. 舌头 (shétou)
etym.舒: 舍 (shè — your note: the same one as in 舍不得 (shěbude)) + 予 (yǔ) — stretched out, at ease: 舒服 (shūfu)
etym.舞: a dancer with sleeves swinging, over 舛 (chuǎn, two feet) — dancing: 跳舞 (tiàowǔ)
etym.般: 舟 (zhōu, boat) + 殳 (shū, a pole) — poling a boat around: a kind, a manner. 一般 (yìbān)
etym.船: 舟 (zhōu, boat) plus the right side it shares with 铅 (qiān) — the boat: 船 (chuán)
etym.节: 艹 (grass) on top — bamboo's knuckled joints in the old 節 (jié): a segment; a festival. 节日 (jiérì)
etym.花: 艹 (plants) + 化 (huà, to change — also gives the sound, huà→huā): what the plant changes into — a flower; to spend. 开花 (kāihuā), 花茶 (huāchá)
etym.苗: 艹 (grass) sprouting over 田 (tián, field) — young shoots: sprout; slender, 苗条 (miáotiao)
etym.英: 艹 (plants) + 央 (yāng, the centre — it hints the sound, yāng→yīng): the flower at its finest — outstanding; borrowed to spell England. 英语 (yīngyǔ)
etym.苹: 艹 (plants) + 平 (píng), which gives the sound — a character kept around for the apple. 苹果 (píngguǒ)
etym.茶: 艹 (grass) + 人 (rén, person) + 木 (mù, tree) — a person up in the tea bush, between leaf and wood: tea
etym.草: blades of grass (艹) over 早 (zǎo), which hints the sound (zǎo→cǎo): grass; rough, as in a draft
etym.药: 艹 (herbs) + 约 (yuē, hints at yào) — the herbs that bind you back together: medicine
etym.菜: 艹 (plants) + 采 (cǎi, a hand picking from a tree — also gives the sound, cǎi→cài): what gets picked for the pot — vegetables; a dish. 菜单 (càidān), 青菜 (qīngcài)
etym.萄: 艹 (plants) + 匋 (táo), which gives the sound — only ever in 葡萄 (pútao), grapes; learn the word
etym.葡: 艹 (plants) + 匍 (pú, to crawl — it gives the sound): the vine that crawls — only in 葡萄 (pútao), grapes
etym.蓝: 艹 (grass) + 监 (jiān) — the indigo plant; it is the sound side it shares with 篮 (lán): blue. 蓝色 (lánsè)
etym.蕉: 艹 (plants) + 焦 (jiāo, scorched — here just the sound): the broad-leafed banana plant. 香蕉 (xiāngjiāo)
etym.虎: 虍 (the stripes) over 几 (jī, its legs) — the tiger drawn whole: a pictograph. 猛虎 (měnghǔ)
etym.虽: 口 (kǒu, mouth) + 虫 (chóng, critter) — an old lizard-word borrowed long ago for although: 虽然 (suīrán)
etym.蛋: 虫 (chóng, critter) under 疋 (pǐ) — where the little creatures come from: egg. 鸡蛋 (jīdàn)
etym.行: a crossroads drawn whole — walking it (xíng, 旅行 (lǚxíng)) and the rows of shops that lined it (háng, 银行 (yínháng))
etym.街: 行 (xíng, crossroads) with 圭 (guī, hints at jiē) set into it: street. 街道 (jiēdào)
etym.衣: a robe drawn with sleeves and crossed lapels — clothes, a pictograph. 衣服 (yīfu)
etym.补: 衤 (the clothes radical) + 卜 (bǔ, which gives the sound): cloth patched over the hole — to mend; to fill in. 替补 (tìbǔ)
etym.表: 衣 (yī, clothes) worn fur side out — the outside: surface, to show; 手表 (shǒubiǎo) sits on the outside of the wrist
etym.衫: 衤 (the clothes radical) + 彡 (shān, streaks — here the sound): a light unlined shirt. 衬衫 (chènshān)
etym.衬: 衤 (clothes) + 寸 (cùn — standing in for 親 (qīn), the old sound side) — the layer an inch from the skin: 衬衫 (chènshān), shirt
etym.被: 衤 (clothing) + 皮 (pí) — the sound side it shares with 波 (bō) and 破 (pò): quilt; the passive marker
etym.裙: 衤 (the clothes radical) + 君 (jūn), which hints the sound (jūn→qún): a skirt. 裙子 (qúnzi)
etym.裤: 衤 (the clothes radical) + 库 (kù, a storehouse — here the sound): trousers. 裤子 (kùzi)
etym.要: 覀 (a cover) + 女 (nǚ, woman) — originally a drawing of the waist (腰 (yāo) still keeps the sound): to want
etym.观: 见 (jiàn, to see) with 又 (yòu) standing in for 雚 (guàn), the old sound side — to view, a sight. 大观园 (Dàguānyuán)
etym.视: 见 (jiàn, seeing) does the meaning; 礻 (shì, the altar) lends only its sound — to view. 电视 (diànshì)
etym.觉: a roof of lashes over 见 (jiàn, see) — eyes opening: to feel (jué); sleep (jiào)
etym.认: 讠 (words) + 人 (rén), which gives the sound (rén→rèn): putting a name to a face — to recognize; to admit. 认识 (rènshi), 认为 (rènwéi)
etym.让: 讠 (words) + 上 (shàng), which hints the sound (shàng→ràng): words that yield the way — to let; to make
etym.议: 讠 (words) + 义 (yì, what is right — also gives the sound): talking over what is right — to discuss. 会议 (huìyì)
etym.记: 讠 (words) + 己 (jǐ), which gives the sound (jǐ→jì): words tied down so they stay put — to record, to remember. 记得 (jìde), 忘记 (wàngjì)
etym.讲: 讠 (speech) + 井 (jǐng, hints at jiǎng) — the same swap 进 (jìn) made: to speak, to explain
etym.识: 讠 (words) + 只 (zhǐ), which hints the sound (zhǐ→shí): to know by name. 认识 (rènshi)
etym.诉: 讠 (speech) + 斥 (chì, to denounce) — speech pressed on someone: to tell. 告诉 (gàosu)
etym.词: 讠 (words) + 司 (sī, to manage — it hints the sound, sī→cí): speech in managed units — a word. 词典 (cídiǎn)
etym.试: 讠 (words) + 式 (shì, a pattern — also gives the sound): tried against the pattern — to test, to try. 考试 (kǎoshì), 口试 (kǒushì)
etym.话: 讠 (speech) + 舌 (shé, tongue) — speech off the tongue: talk
etym.该: 讠 (words) + 亥 (hài), which hints the sound (hài→gāi): what the rules say for you — should. 应该 (yīnggāi)
etym.语: 讠 (words) + 吾 (wú, I — it hints the sound, wú→yǔ): speech passing between people — language. 汉语 (Hànyǔ), 英语 (yīngyǔ)
etym.说: 讠 (speech) + 兑 (duì) — the sound side it shares with 悦 (yuè): to speak
etym.请: 讠 (words) + 青 (qīng), which gives the sound (qīng→qǐng): asking in good words — please; to invite. 请问 (qǐngwèn), 请假 (qǐngjià)
etym.读: 讠 (speech) + 卖 (mài, sell) — hawking the text aloud: to read
etym.课: 讠 (speech) + 果 (guǒ, hints at kè) — graded speech: a lesson
etym.谁: 讠 (speech) + 隹 (zhuī, hints at shuí) — who is speaking?
etym.调: 讠 (speech) + 周 (zhōu, hints at diào) — tuning speech: tone diào, adjust tiáo. 空调 (kōngtiáo)
etym.谢: 讠 (speech) + 射 (shè, hints at xiè) — words shot back in return: thanks
etym.贡: 工 (gōng, which gives the sound: gōng→gòng) over 贝 (bèi, cowrie money): wealth sent up to the court — tribute; to contribute. 贡献 (gòngxiàn)
etym.财: 贝 (bèi, cowrie money) + 才 (cái, which gives the sound): wealth. 发财 (fācái)
etym.败: 贝 (bèi, shell-money — and nearly the sound) + 攵 (a striking hand) — wealth beaten to bits: defeat. 败诉 (bàisù)
etym.货: 化 (huà, hints at huò) + 贝 (bèi, shell-money) — what money changes into: goods. 货物 (huòwù)
etym.贷: 代 (dài, to stand in — also gives the sound) over 贝 (bèi, money): money standing in for money you don't have — a loan. 贷款 (dàikuǎn)
etym.费: 弗 (fú, hints at fèi) + 贝 (bèi, money) — money flying apart: expense; 免费 (miǎnfèi), free
etym.走: a man flinging his arms over a striding foot — running: to go, to walk
etym.起: 走 (the running radical) + 己 (jǐ), which hints the sound (jǐ→qǐ): getting to your feet — to rise, to begin. 一起 (yìqǐ), 起床 (qǐchuáng)
etym.超: 走 (the running radical) + 召 (zhào), which hints the sound (zhào→chāo): overtaking at a run — to exceed; super. 超市 (chāoshì), 超级 (chāojí)
etym.越: 走 (the running radical) + 戉 (yuè, an old axe — here just the sound): to cross over, to exceed. 越来越 (yuèláiyuè)
etym.趣: 走 (the running radical) + 取 (qǔ, to grab — also gives the sound, qǔ→qù): what you run over to grab — interest, delight. 感兴趣 (gǎn xìngqù)
etym.足: a foot below a knee drawn square — the whole leg: foot. 足球 (zúqiú)
etym.趾: 足 (zú, the foot) + 止 (zhǐ, originally a footprint — also gives the sound): the toes. 脚趾头 (jiǎozhǐtou)
etym.跑: 足 (the foot) + 包 (bāo), which hints the sound (bāo→pǎo): feet pounding the ground — to run. 跑步 (pǎobù)
etym.距: 足 (the foot) + 巨 (jù, which gives the sound): originally a rooster's spur; now the span between two points — distance. 距离 (jùlí)
etym.跟: 足 (the foot) + 艮 (gěn, which gives the sound: gěn→gēn): the heel — and to follow at someone's heel: with. 跟我读 (gēn wǒ dú)
etym.路: a foot 足 (zú) + 各 (gè) — the sound side it shares with 落 (luò) and 略 (lüè): road
etym.跳: 足 (zú, foot) + 兆 (zhào, hints at tiào) — feet leaving the ground: to jump. 跳舞 (tiàowǔ)
etym.踢: 足 (the foot) + 易 (yì), which hints the sound (yì→tī): to kick. 踢足球 (tī zúqiú)
etym.蹲: 足 (the feet) + 尊 (zūn), which hints the sound (zūn→dūn): folded down onto your heels — to squat
etym.轻: 车 (chē, a chariot) + the same right side as 经 (jīng), its sound shifted jīng→qīng: the fast light war-cart — light. 年轻 (niánqīng)
etym.较: 车 (chē, a chariot) + 交 (jiāo, crossing — it gives the sound, jiāo→jiào): axles pulled up side by side and measured — to compare. 比较 (bǐjiào)
etym.辆: 车 (chē, a cart) + 两 (liǎng, a pair — also gives the sound, liǎng→liàng): counted by its pair of wheels — the measure word for vehicles
etym.辈: 非 (fēi, which hints the sound: fēi→bèi) over 车 (chē, carts): carts drawn up rank on rank — a generation. 长辈 (zhǎngbèi)
etym.边: 辶 (walk) + 力 (lì) — all that survived of the old sound side of 邊 (biān): edge, side
etym.过: 辶 (walk) + 寸 (cùn, inch) — passing by, inch after inch: to pass
etym.迎: 辶 (walk) + 卬 (áng, hints at yíng) — walking out to meet: to welcome. 欢迎 (huānyíng)
etym.运: 辶 (the road) + 云 (yún, which gives the sound: yún→yùn): things carried along the road — to transport; luck in motion. 运动 (yùndòng)
etym.近: 辶 (the road) + 斤 (jīn, which gives the sound: jīn→jìn): a short road — near. 最近 (zuìjìn), 附近 (fùjìn)
etym.还: 辶 (walk) + 不 (bù, no) — walking back even so: to return (huán); still (hái)
etym.这: 辶 (walk) + 文 (wén, writing) — walking over to point at the writing: this
etym.进: 辶 (walk) + 井 (jǐng, hints at jìn) — simplified from 進 (jìn): to enter
etym.远: 辶 (the road) + 元 (yuán, which gives the sound: yuán→yuǎn): a long road — far. 很远 (hěn yuǎn), 永远 (yǒngyuǎn)
etym.迟: 辶 (the road) + 尺 (chǐ, a foot-rule — it gives the sound, chǐ→chí): going by measured steps, arriving after — late. 迟到 (chídào)
etym.送: 辶 (walk) + 关 (guān, the gate) — walking a guest to the gate: to see off, to send
etym.选: 辶 (the road) + 先 (xiān, ahead — it hints the sound, xiān→xuǎn): sending the picked ones ahead — to choose. 选择 (xuǎnzé)
etym.递: 辶 (the road) + 弟 (dì, which gives the sound): passed hand to hand down the road — to hand over, to deliver. 快递 (kuàidì)
etym.遇: 辶 (the road) + 禺 (yú), which gives the sound (yú→yù): paths crossing — to meet by chance. 遇到 (yùdào)
etym.遍: 辶 (the road) + 扁 (biǎn, which gives the sound: biǎn→biàn): the road walked end to end — all over; one time through. 再读一遍 (zài dú yí biàn)
etym.道: 辶 (walk) + 首 (shǒu, head) — the way the head chooses: road
etym.那: 阝 (place) on the right — an old place-name loaned out for pointing: that. 那个 (nàge)
etym.邮: 由 (yóu, which gives the sound) + 阝 (the town radical): the relay towns a letter hopped between — mail. 电子邮件 (diànzǐ yóujiàn)
etym.邻: 令 (lìng, the sound side — lìng to lín, like 领 (lǐng)) + 阝 (place) — the households ordered next to yours: neighbor. 邻居 (línjū)
etym.部: 咅 (pǒu, the sound side, drifted to bù) + 阝 (place) — a district, a section: 部分 (bùfen)
etym.都: 者 (zhě, the sound side, dū drifted to dōu) + 阝 (a city) — the capital; hence all. 都会 (dōu huì)
etym.酒: 氵 (water) + 酉 (yǒu, the wine jar) — the liquid out of the jar: alcohol. 啤酒 (píjiǔ)
etym.酸: vinegar out of the 酉 (yǒu, wine jar) — wine gone over: sour; the last word of the sour-grapes saying. 酸 (suān)
etym.里: 田 (tián, field) over 土 (tǔ, earth) — the home fields: inside
etym.野: 里 (lǐ, the home fields) + 予 (yǔ, the sound side, drifted to yě) — beyond the fields: wild. 野人 (yěrén)
etym.量: grain weighed out — to measure, an amount. 里 (lǐ) hints the sound (lǐ→liàng). 力量 (lìliàng), 数量 (shùliàng)
etym.针: 钅 (metal) + 十 (shí, a needle with its thread-eye crossed): needle. 别针 (biézhēn)
etym.钟: 钅 (metal) + 中 (zhōng, which gives the sound): the cast bell, then the clock that took its job — o'clock. 分钟 (fēnzhōng), 一刻钟 (yíkèzhōng)
etym.钢: 钅 (metal) + 冈 (gāng, a ridge — also gives the sound): iron hardened to a ridge-line edge — steel. 钢笔 (gāngbǐ)
etym.钱: 钅 (metal) + 戋 (jiān), which hints the sound (jiān→qián): metal struck into coins — money. 块钱 (kuàiqián)
etym.铁: 钅 (metal) + 失 (shī) — a stand-in sound side from the old 鐵 (tiě): iron. 地铁 (dìtiě)
etym.铅: 钅 (metal) + the right side of 船 (chuán), read yán in 沿 (yán) — the soft grey metal: lead. 铅笔 (qiānbǐ)
etym.银: 钅 (metal) + 艮 (gèn) — the sound side it shares with 很 (hěn) and 根 (gēn): silver. 银行 (yínháng)
etym.错: 钅 (metal) + 昔 (xī, former days) — old bronze inlay gone wrong: mistake
etym.锻: 钅 (metal) + 段 (duàn, which gives the sound): metal hammered section by section — to forge; to train the body. 锻炼 (duànliàn)
etym.问: 门 (mén, hints at wèn) around 口 (kǒu, mouth) — a mouth at the door, asking. 请问 (qǐngwèn)
etym.间: 门 (mén, hints at jiān) around 日 (rì, sun) — sunlight through the crack of the door: between; a room
etym.闻: 门 (mén, hints at wén) around 耳 (ěr, ear) — an ear at the door: to hear. 新闻 (xīnwén)
etym.阳: 阝 (the hillside) + 日 (rì, sun) — the sunny slope: yang, the sun. 太阳 (tàiyáng)
etym.阴: 阝 (the hillside) + 月 (yuè, moon) — the shaded slope: yin, overcast. 阴天 (yīntiān)
etym.阿: 阝 (hill) + 可 (kě, the sound side, softened to ā) — the name-prefix: 阿姨 (āyí)
etym.附: 阝 (the hill radical) + 付 (fù, to hand over — also gives the sound): pressed up close against — attached; nearby. 附近 (fùjìn)
etym.院: 阝 (place) + 完 (wán, hints at yuàn) — walled grounds: courtyard, institution. 医院 (yīyuàn)
etym.除: 阝 (the steps of a mound) + 余 (yú), which hints the sound (yú→chú): sweeping the steps clear — to remove; except. 除了 (chúle)
etym.难: 又 (a hand) + 隹 (zhuī, bird) — hard to catch a bird bare-handed: difficult
etym.雪: 雨 (yǔ, rain) + 彐 (a hand with a broom) — rain you can sweep: snow
etym.零: 雨 (yǔ, rain) + 令 (lìng), which gives the sound (lìng→líng): the last scattered drops of a shower — odd bits; then nothing left: zero
etym.雹: 雨 (yǔ, rain) + 包 (bāo, wrapped round — also gives the sound, bāo→báo): rain balled up hard — hail. 冰雹 (bīngbáo)
etym.需: 雨 (yǔ, rain) + 而 (ér) — stuck waiting for the rain to stop: to need. 需要 (xūyào)
etym.震: 雨 (yǔ, a storm) + 辰 (chén), which hints the sound (chén→zhèn): the storm that shakes the ground — to quake. 震央 (zhènyāng)
etym.青: sprouting 生 (shēng) over 丹 (dān, a well of dye) — the green-blue that lends its sound to 请 (qǐng), 清 (qīng), 情 (qíng), 晴 (qíng) and 睛 (jīng)
etym.静: 青 (qīng, green, calm) + 争 (zhēng, hints at jìng) — stillness after contention: quiet. 安静 (ānjìng)
etym.面: a face drawn around 目 (mù, an eye): face, surface — and the noodles of 面条 (miàntiáo)
etym.鞋: 革 (gé, leather) + 圭 (guī, hints at xié — the same sound side as 街 (jiē)): shoes. 皮鞋 (píxié)
etym.音: 言 (yán, words) with a mark on the tongue in the old graph — sound leaving the mouth: 音乐 (yīnyuè)
etym.顺: 川 (chuān, a river) + 页 (yè, a head) — the head going the way the river runs: to go along with. 孝顺 (xiàoshùn)
etym.须: 彡 (hairs) + 页 (yè, a head) — whiskers on the face: 胡须 (húxū); borrowed for 必须 (bìxū), must
etym.顾: 厄 (è) — what is left of 雇 (gù), the sound side — + 页 (yè, a head) turning: to look after. 照顾 (zhàogù)
etym.题: originally the forehead — 页 (yè, a head) with 是 (shì) hinting the sound (shì→tí, as in 提 (tí)): what stands at the front — a title, a topic, a question. 问题 (wèntí)
etym.颜: 页 (yè, a head) + 彦 (yàn), which gives the sound (yàn→yán): the face — and the color it shows. 颜色 (yánsè)
etym.风: the sail-shape of the old 風 (fēng), the 虫 (chóng) inside blown away — wind. 刮风 (guāfēng)
etym.食: a lid over a full food vessel — a meal: food. 美食 (měishí)
etym.饭: 饣 (the food radical) + 反 (fǎn), which gives the sound (fǎn→fàn): cooked rice — a meal. 吃饭 (chīfàn), 午饭 (wǔfàn)
etym.饮: 饣 (food) + 欠 (qiàn, an open mouth) — mouth open over the jar: to drink. 饮料 (yǐnliào)
etym.饱: 饣 (food) + 包 (bāo, stuffed full — also gives the sound, bāo→bǎo): full
etym.饿: 饣 (food) + 我 (wǒ, the old sound side, drifted to è) — me, thinking about food: hungry
etym.馆: 饣 (the food radical) + 官 (guān, which gives the sound: guān→guǎn): the house that fed official travelers — then any public hall. 饭馆 (fànguǎn), 图书馆 (túshūguǎn)
etym.香: 禾 (hé, grain) over what was once a mouth — the smell of cooking rice: fragrant. 香蕉 (xiāngjiāo)
etym.骑: 马 (mǎ, a horse) + 奇 (qí, which gives the sound): astride the horse — to ride
etym.高: a watchtower drawn storey over storey — a pictograph: tall
etym.鱼: a fish drawn whole — head, scaled body, and a tail flattened to 一 (yī): fish
etym.鲜: 鱼 (yú, fish) + 羊 (yáng, sheep) — the two freshest flavors on one plate: fresh. 新鲜 (xīnxiān)
etym.鲤: 鱼 (yú, fish) + 里 (lǐ, which gives the sound): the carp. 鲤鱼 (lǐyú), 鲤鱼跳龙门 (lǐyú tiào lóngmén)
etym.鸡: 又 (a hand, standing in for 奚 (xī), the old sound side) + 鸟 (niǎo, bird) — the yard bird: chicken. 鸡蛋 (jīdàn)
etym.鸭: 甲 (jiǎ, the old sound side, drifted to yā) + 鸟 (niǎo, bird) — the quacker: duck. 鸭蛋 (yādàn)
etym.鹅: 我 (wǒ, the sound side — é a slide off wǒ) + 鸟 (niǎo, bird) — goose. 鹅蛋 (é dàn)
etym.黄: a man wearing a jade pendant in the old graph — the color of the jade: yellow. 黄河 (Huáng Hé)
etym.鼻: 自 (zì, the nose pictograph — people point at their own nose for 'me') + 畀 (bì), which gives the sound (bì→bí): the nose. 鼻子 (bízi)
etym.龙: the coiled dragon of 龍 (lóng), shrunk to a scribble — dragon. 鲤鱼跳龙门 (lǐyú tiào lóngmén)
